methodology: Hardware identified by WebGPU adapter plus native device report; eight browser configurations in seven randomized rounds with interleaved native control, then eleven alternating confirmation pairs. 16,777,216 candidates per round. Initialization/prefix preparation excluded. Wall includes submission, mapping and winner verification; GPU timestamps cover mining pass only. Warm proof uses a preselected 256-nonce winning window, not network block time. No physical traffic or register/occupancy counters inferred.
